instruction: Go to HuggingFace and find the daily papers published on March 1, 2024. Supplement the document with additional paper metadata following the existing format (Title, Authors, Abstract, Arxiv PDF).

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(1); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding papers from HuggingFace (March 1, 2024) and adding entries to docx. Original has 2 'Title:' entries. Evaluator counts title entries. Expected: at least 3 titles. Verified source has 2 titles.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Instruction requires adding complete paper entries with Title, Authors, Abstract, and Arxiv PDF, but evaluator only checks for 'Title:' entries
Missing metadata verification: User could add just 'Title: Random Paper' without Authors, Abstract, or Arxiv PDF and still pass evaluation
No format verification: Evaluator doesn't check if added entries follow the existing format pattern
No content quality check: Evaluator doesn't verify that added papers are actually from HuggingFace or from March 1, 2024
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getters to count 'Authors:', 'Abstract:', and 'Arxiv PDF:' entries and verify all four metadata fields are present for each paper
Modify evaluator to check that the number of Titles, Authors, Abstracts, and Arxiv PDF entries are all equal and >= 3
Consider adding pattern matching to verify format consistency (e.g., each Title is followed by Authors, Abstract, and Arxiv PDF in order)
For stricter verification, could add checks for HuggingFace URL patterns or date references, though this may be overly restrictive
